gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1083. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Gullane Road (嘉齡道): Road commencing at its junction with Argyle Street, running south-easterly, and terminating at its junction with Perth Street as shown coloured red on plan No. R.K. 134 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 8th September, 1950.

No. 1083. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Nairn Road (楠道): Road commencing at Argyle Street near Waterloo Road, running south-easterly, as shown coloured red on plan No. R.K. 133 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 8th September, 1950.

No. 1083. PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Perth Street (巴富街): Road parallel to and south-east of Argyle Street, commencing at Nairn Road, running north-easterly, and terminating at Mission Road as shown coloured red on plan No. R.K. 135 signed by the Director of Public Works and dated 8th September, 1950.
